item_reviews.comment: Beam variant has best Auto MS 0.72, Lev 0.32, Human MS 0.55, Lev 0.17 across all rows.
Values check: ROUGE-L 42.98 below r1/r5; FactCC 0.64 below Claude 0.70; AlignScore 0.3890 barely above 0.3888.
Auto MS/Lev improved, human MS tied 0.24, human Lev worse 0.65 vs 0.49; ROUGE-L far lower, FactCC higher.
Fine-tuned is actually worse or equal on all structural metrics; 'not consistently improve' understates but is true. ROUGE-L down, FactCC up.
Note states single run, no significance tests, two annotators, 100 summaries per model.

missing_core_findings.description: Automatic structural metrics use the same discourse classifier that guides Method M (and selects best-of-16 for vanilla baselines), so the automatic advantage may be partly circular. Only the human evaluation, on 100 summaries from two annotators, is independent, though it also favors the beam variant.
